description: This file defines functions related to determining and configuring Python installation schemes using distutils and pip internals. It handles locating installation directories, managing virtual environments, and parsing configuration files for package installation paths.

classes.name: Scheme
classes.description: A data class representing various installation directory schemes for Python packages.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] distutils_scheme( dist_name: str, user: bool = False, home: Optional[str] = None, root: Optional[str] = None, isolated: bool = False, prefix: Optional[str] = None, *, ignore_config_files: bool = False, )
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of directory paths for a given package using distutils, considering options like user installation, home, root, and isolation.

methods.name: Scheme get_scheme( dist_name: str, user: bool = False, home: Optional[str] = None, root: Optional[str] = None, isolated: bool = False, prefix: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Scheme object encapsulating installation paths based on provided parameters.

methods.name: str get_bin_prefix()
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate directory prefix for executables, considering platform specifics.

methods.name: str get_purelib()
methods.description: Returns the path to the platform-independent library directory.

methods.name: str get_platlib()
methods.description: Returns the path to the platform-specific library directory.
